dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look at all this packaging! We only bought snacks and drinks.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət ˈɔːl ˈðɪs ˈpækɪdʒɪŋ! wiː ˈoʊnli ˈbɔːt ˈsnæks ənd ˈdrɪŋks.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. Plastic is used for almost everything here.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ˈplæstɪk ɪz ˈjuːzd fər ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What happens to it after we throw it away?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈhæpənz tə ɪt ˈæftər wiː ˈθroʊ ɪt əˈweɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Most of it is taken to a huge dump outside the city.
dialogue.reading: ˈmoʊst əv ɪt ɪz ˈteɪkən tə ə ˈhjuːdʒ ˈdʌmp ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈsɪti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A dump? Does anyone recycle it?
dialogue.reading: ə ˈdʌmp? dʌz ˈɛniwʌn riːˈsaɪkəl ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Some bottles and cans are recycled, but a lot of plastic is burned.
dialogue.reading: sʌm ˈbɑːtəlz ənd ˈkænz ər riːˈsaɪkəld, bʌt ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈplæstɪk ɪz ˈbɜːrnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. And some plastic waste is dumped in rivers. Then it goes into the sea.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ənd sʌm ˈplæstɪk ˈweɪst ɪz ˈdʌmpt ɪn ˈrɪvərz. ˈðɛn ɪt ˈɡoʊz ˈɪntuː ðə ˈsiː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We can recycle our bottles, and we can say no to plastic bags.
dialogue.reading: wiː kən riːˈsaɪkəl aʊr ˈbɑːtəlz, ənd wiː kən ˈseɪ ˈnoʊ tə ˈplæstɪk ˈbæɡz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea. I'll bring a bag next time we go shopping.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. aɪl ˈbrɪŋ ə ˈbæɡ ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm wiː ˈɡoʊ ˈʃɑːpɪŋ.
